name: Roman the Great
contribution: He founded the Romanovichi branch of Rurikids, which would rule Galicia–Volhynia until 1340.
legacy: According to Vasily Tatishchev, this person supposedly envisioned a project of reforming the government model of Rus' by establishing primogeniture in the six biggest principalities - Galicia-Volhynia, Vladimir-Suzdal, Polotsk, Chernigov, Smolensk and Ryazan - with the rulers of those principalities electing the Prince of Kyiv in a manner similar to prince-electors of the Holy this person Empire.

checks.lead: Roman Mstislavich (c. 4 April 1152 – 19 June 1205), also known as Roman the Great, was Prince of Novgorod (1168–1170), Volhynia (1170–1189; 1189–1205), and Galicia (1189; 1198/99–1205). He founded the Romanovichi branch of Rurikids, which would rule Galicia–Volhynia until 1340.
